original.target_description: Study 3; between-subjects ANOVA of laptop screen-size judgments in inches under high versus low red color saturation; 77 undergraduate participants after three incomplete questionnaires were excluded.

n.exclusions: 80 recruited; three did not complete questionnaires; 77 analyzed. One self-reported color-blind participant was retained.

notes:
Reported success is the authors’ study-level narrative verdict.
Source follow-up: Fresh original-only extraction from the published article; title, authors and DOI match the assigned reference. PDF page 5 (printed p. 400) was rendered and visually checked. Canonical-text quotes retain the supplied parse glyphs: ¼ represents the rendered equals sign and gp2 represents rendered partial eta-squared. Numeric meanings and F degrees of freedom were verified on the rendered page. No conversion performed. The supplied p. 15 locator points to Appendix D stimulus images for Studies 5 and 6, not the Study 3 target test. The explicitly named Study 3 laptop size comparison is reported on PDF p. 5, printed p. 400; no appendix statistic was substituted. The unassigned replication and reported_success fields are placeholders and were not examined.
